task_title: Board publish-drift check: the registered workdir board must be byte-identical to the published board, and the check must be able to fail
task_criteria: scripts/board_drift.py compares a workdir board (tasks.jsonl and events.jsonl) against a published ref (default origin/main), prints PASS with measured sha256 and row counts on parity, and FAILs with named divergent row ids (status differs or row missing) plus a row-count delta
Fail-closed: a missing board file, an unreadable file, a missing git, or a bad ref prints a named FAIL and exits nonzero; a zero-row board is a named FAIL, never a silent pass

tests/selftest.sh gains an arm that proves the check RED against a fixture whose rows were re-opened/missing and GREEN against a matching fixture, plus the fail-closed states; SELFTEST: PASS and scripts/boardctl validate RESULT: OK at the fixed tip
docs/BOARD.md documents the re-runnable census command and the measured pre-fix drift (61 vs 88 rows; CF-053/CF-064/CF-065/CF-075/PERF-014 pending in the stale copy while complete at origin/main)

CF-053, CF-064, CF-065, CF-075 and PERF-014 read pending there while complete at origin/main.'
